summary: Iteration 34 mobile-admin + Datensicherung tab tested end-to-end. All 7 required behaviors pass: (1) /admin/login → /admin redirect after login on iPhone 390×844; (2) burger + sub-header + off-canvas drawer with body-scroll-lock, X-close, backdrop-close, auto-close on tab select all work; (3) new Datensicherung tab renders BackupManager with status KPIs (Datensätze=196, Sammlungen=26), download button, schedule toggle exposing Windows/macOS/Linux scripts + Kopieren button; (4) AdminToolbar 'Verwaltung' icon visible + clickable on mobile viewport, navigates to /admin; (5) bs-backup-section removed from BusinessSettingsManager while bs-smtp-section + logo section preserved; (6) Desktop 1920 keeps sidebar visible, burger hidden, sub-header hidden, tab order confirms backup as 5th item between business and users; (7) Iteration 33 regression pytest suite (9 tests: backup status/mongo/scripts + users CRUD) all pass. iPad 768×1024 also uses drawer (Tailwind lg=1024).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx renders the SidebarTabs helper twice (Desktop sidebar + Mobile drawer). This creates duplicate data-testid=admin-tab-* nodes at viewports where BOTH are rendered simultaneously (only the drawer is conditionally rendered via menuOpen so in practice at most one set is in DOM at a time, but tests must still scope by parent test-id). Non-blocking.
AdminLogin.jsx correctly uses <Navigate to='/admin' replace/> for already-authenticated visitors AND nav('/admin') after successful login — both paths verified.
BackupManager.jsx: OS auto-detection via navigator.platform is fine, but consider navigator.userAgentData.platform as fallback for future browsers deprecating navigator.platform. Cosmetic only.

Mobile drawer uses onClick on the outer container for backdrop-close and e.stopPropagation on the inner panel — clean pattern. body.overflow reset is done in the cleanup of the useEffect which correctly handles unmount.

AdminToolbar's 'Verwaltung' link on mobile is icon-only (37×29 px hit-target) — this is at the lower bound of the recommended 44 px iOS touch-target but still tappable. Consider bumping padding on Mobile.
seed_data_creation: None (existing admin + existing 'Stefan Haas' + 'Tim TESTJ...' students reused). Users CRUD test creates + deletes its own throw-away user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 34 was frontend-only (mobile admin drawer + new Datensicherung tab). Backend backup endpoints (/api/backup/status, /api/backup/mongo, /api/backup/scripts) were untouched and remain green. Data-testid scoping tip: because AdminDashboard renders the SidebarTabs helper twice (desktop <aside data-testid=admin-sidebar> + mobile <div data-testid=admin-drawer>), always scope tab-clicks by their parent test-id: page.locator('[data-testid=admin-drawer] [data-testid=admin-tab-XXX]') or page.locator('[data-testid=admin-sidebar] [data-testid=admin-tab-XXX]') to avoid ambiguity. At mobile viewport only the drawer is rendered, at desktop only the sidebar is rendered — but tests should stay scope-safe. Mobile breakpoint = Tailwind lg (>=1024px shows sidebar).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. First run of the playwright script had a click-race (wait_for_url('**/admin**') matches '/admin/login' immediately), fixed by waiting for [data-testid=admin-dashboard] instead. This is a test-script issue, not an app issue.
